classification.difficultyReason: Interpret equal-side marks and infer missing total dimensions of stepped shapes, then form, simplify and factorise their perimeter expressions.

content.prompt: Find the perimeters of these shapes and factorise your answer.

spec.description: Unshaded rectangle wider than tall; 2x below the bottom edge and 4 outside the right edge. No equality or right-angle marks. Ordinary source-blue outline is reconstructed in house-style black.
spec.mathematics: Rectangle with width 2x and height 4; opposite sides have equal lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; the supplied perimeter answer is excluded.

spec.description: Unshaded isosceles triangle with horizontal base, apex above it, double equality ticks on both sloping sides, x outside the right side and 6 below the base. Ordinary source-blue outline is reconstructed in house-style black.
spec.mathematics: Both sloping sides have length x and the base has length 6.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and equality marks are visible; the supplied perimeter answer is excluded.

spec.description: Unshaded parallelogram with horizontal top and bottom and sides sloping up to the right. Double ticks on the horizontal edges; single ticks on the sloping edges. Labels 10 below the bottom and 5x outside the right side. No parallel arrows. Ordinary source-blue outline is reconstructed in house-style black.
spec.mathematics: Two sides have length 10 and two sides have length 5x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and equality marks are visible; the supplied perimeter answer is excluded.

spec.description: Unshaded rectilinear L shape with a full top bar, downward left leg and lower-right cut-out. Labels 5 above the full top, 2 outside the short right vertical edge and x to the right of the inner vertical edge. No equality or right-angle markers. Ordinary source-blue outline is reconstructed in house-style black.
spec.mathematics: Overall width is 5 and overall height is x+2. The horizontal boundary lengths total twice the width; vertical boundary lengths total twice the height.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; inferred dimensions and the supplied perimeter answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
The horizontal edges total $2\times5$; the vertical edges total $2(x+2)$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=2(5)+2(x+2)\\P&=2x+14\\P&=2(7+x)\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded rectilinear L shape with a full top bar, downward left leg and lower-right cut-out. Matching double ticks on the full left vertical edge and inner horizontal edge. Label 1 below the short bottom-left edge and x+1 below the inner horizontal edge. Ordinary source-blue outline is reconstructed in house-style black.
spec.mathematics: The ticks give overall height x+1. Overall width is 1+(x+1)=x+2. The perimeter is twice the overall width plus twice the overall height.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and equality marks are visible; inferred dimensions and the supplied perimeter answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
The ticks give height $x+1$. The width is $1+(x+1)=x+2$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=2(x+2)+2(x+1)\\P&=4x+6\\P&=2(2x+3)\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded rectilinear stepped shape with a full top bar, downward right extension and lower-left cut-out. Label 3 outside the left vertical edge, 4 outside the full right vertical edge and x below the inner horizontal edge. Matching double ticks on the left vertical edge and short bottom-right horizontal edge. Ordinary source-blue outline is reconstructed in house-style black.
spec.mathematics: The short bottom-right edge has length 3 by the equality ticks. Overall width is x+3 and overall height is 4. The perimeter is twice the overall width plus twice the overall height.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and equality marks are visible; inferred dimensions and the supplied perimeter answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
The ticks give bottom-right length $3$, so the overall width is $x+3$. The height is $4$.
$$\begin{align*}P&=2(x+3)+2(4)\\P&=2x+14\\P&=2(x+7)\end{align*}$$
